$Comment:
The sawmill's two bonus-PLANK ladders, kept apart from the find tiers on purpose: a find is a different item shaken loose from the log (SawmillLuckFinds owns those), while everything here adds more of the very thing the cycle just made. Referenced from this pack's Extensions/SawmillProgression.json Bonus.Lootables.

Grants.OutputItems is ADDITIVE extra units of the cycle's own primary output, never a copy of the produced stack, so these numbers stay directly comparable to the jar action's own Recipe.Yield and no file here can silently multiply another's quantity. The amount is FRACTIONAL: the whole part is granted every time and the leftover fraction is the chance of one more, so 1.5 pays one plank always plus a second half the time and averages exactly 1.5. Everything a cycle grants is summed before that single resolution, so two rolls paying 0.5 each average one whole plank rather than rounding twice.

TWO LADDERS, ONE STATEMENT EACH. The first pays for TIME SERVED and reads Woodcutting's main line alone (GatherSpeed_Woodcutting, half a point for each point spent on the Woodcutting tree, never the level itself, so a plank arrives as the points are spent); the second pays for LUCK INVESTED and reads the luck channels alone. Neither borrows the other's factors, so what each rewards is legible from its Factors block without arithmetic. That separation is also why the two use deliberately DIFFERENT floor numbers from each other and from SawmillLuckFinds: identical Mins over three different scores would invite reading one ladder's threshold as another's.

WHAT A CYCLE ACTUALLY YIELDS. The jar action's Recipe.Yield authors 1 plank, its own tool ladder adds up to 4 more on the drop-only trophy hatchet, and the two ladders here add up to 3 from the tree (4 with gear past it) plus up to 2 (luck), so a fully invested worker mills about ten planks from one log and a newcomer mills one; the Crafting tree's chance of one more (Mmo_Sawmill_Talents) comes on top.

The time-served ladder reads GatherSpeed_Woodcutting, the Woodcutting tree's main line: a server running a Woodcutting tree without that stat reads 0 here and pays nothing, exactly as for a worker who has spent no points. Retune any rung here without touching the jar; retune the tool curve in the jar's own Bonus.Rolls.

All floor thresholds and grants here are initial balance and retune freely without any engine change.

THE MILL TRADE. Two Crafting talents read off the talent's own record (ziggfreedcommon:track_pick) retune these ladders: under Treasure Cut both pay nothing (this table's Requires, whose Not shuts it for that talent's holder alone, so a player without it, and a server with Crafting switched off or no Crafting track at all, is paid as always), and under Bulk Order each pays twice (Mmo_Sawmill_Bulk_Order, the second payment, which rolls for that talent's holder alone). The jar's own tool ladder is the jar's and pays as always.

Rolls.$Comment: The time-served ladder: Woodcutting's main line alone (GatherSpeed_Woodcutting), no luck and no Conditions, so it pays every worker something once they have spent points on the Woodcutting tree. Its floors sit where a quarter-cap level's points land (the points of level 25, 50, 75 and 100 are 24, 49, 74 and 99, half a point of the stat each: 12, 24.5, 37 and 49.5), so a woodcutter who spends every point earns the same planks here as one who reached that level; the 62 floor is past the tree, for gear or a buff that carries the stat. Floors are highest-wins and NOT cumulative, so a worker with 90 points spent gets exactly two bonus planks here and never four. The first two floors deliberately share the same grant of 1: the second pays nothing new, which is what makes the third feel like the real step up.

The luck-invested ladder, and the reason luck is worth stacking at a bench that already pays for levels: luck alone buys planks here, with no level term anywhere in the score. Its three factors are exactly the luck half of SawmillLuckFinds' five - the shared GatherYield plus the station's own WOODCUTTING channel at full weight and the adjacent CRAFTING channel at half, mirroring the action's own 8.0/4.0 XP split. Levels are deliberately ABSENT: the ladder above already pays for them, and reading them here too would pay the same progression twice.

The reachable band is about 179 points (98 from a full WOODCUTTING tree, 55.5 from a full CRAFTING tree after its 0.5 weight, 25 from the trophy hatchet while held, a point or two of mastery loot multiplier; the shared GatherYield ships empty and is here so gear and other packs compose for free), which is what the floors are sized against - 160 is a real destination rather than an unreachable label. See SawmillLuckFinds' own comment for the whole-percent-points unit note that governs these numbers.

Every grant is FRACTIONAL on purpose, the schema feature that lets a rung be worth half a step: the first two floors pay less than a whole plank, so early luck investment is felt as a plank arriving every few cycles rather than as nothing until some distant threshold. 0.25 means one extra plank on one cycle in four.
